title: Application crashes during startup
description: The browser crashes immediately after startup when the user opens the application.
comments: The startup initialization sequence was corrected.

title: Memory leak in browser tab
description: Memory usage continuously increases when multiple tabs are opened and closed repeatedly.
comments: Memory resources were not released correctly.

title: Login page displays error
description: Users receive an unexpected error when submitting valid login credentials.
comments: The authentication request handling was updated.

title: Server returns HTTP 500
description: The server returns an HTTP 500 error when processing a specific request.

title: Configuration file not loaded
description: The application fails to start because the configuration file is not loaded correctly.
comments: The configuration file path handling was corrected.

title: Database connection timeout
description: The application reports a database connection timeout during high request volume.

title: IDE freezes during build
description: The IDE becomes unresponsive while building a large Java project.
comments: Build process resource management was improved.

title: Null pointer exception
description: A null pointer exception occurs when opening a project with missing configuration information.

title: Plugin installation fails
description: Plugin installation fails when dependency information is incomplete.
